title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, or, a Dictionary of arts, sciences, and miscellaneous literature : enlarged and improved. Illustrated with nearly six hundred engravings - Fifth edition, Volume 13, MAT-MIC - EB.10
text: MELISSA, in fabulous history, a daughter of Me-liflus King of Crete, who visit her father Amalibanes fed Jupiter with the milk of goats. She fril found out the means of collecting honey; whence it has been fabled that she was changed into a bee, as her name is the Great weed for that infect.
